user.title: Connect GRYFSMART
user.description: Choose Ethernet or RS-232. Modules and entities are discovered automatically without changing module addresses.

ethernet.title: Ethernet — ETH0606T
ethernet.description: Enter the ETH address. Application TCP port: 5000. Disconnect other clients using this port.

serial.title: RS-232 — Home Assistant serial port
serial.description: Select the adapter attached to HA, or enter /dev/serial/by-id/… Settings: 115200, 8N1. Pass the adapter to the VM/container if applicable. Connect from logical port 0.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect. Check the address, port, wiring and whether another application is using the connection.
error.firmware_required: Update module firmware: ETH ≥25, R0808 ≥25, R0806T ≥27, S0804 ≥27, OLD ≥4.

abort.already_configured: This GRYFSMART connection is already configured.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect. Check the connection and port access.
error.wrong_gateway: This is a different ETH gateway. Add it as a separate connection.
